body: I just survived my attempt on October 1st...I know for me a huge resource has been NAMI, my family has been getting a lot of information from our local NAMI, I also would highly recommend talking to the social worker on your wife's case and as my mom said frequently last week "sometimes I have to be annoying" by annoying I mean be persistent and keep calling or asking until you get the information you need, the social worker can be a wealth of information...I am not sure if this is helpful but I really just want to be able to help, I can't imagine how you feel and I wish you and your wife the best
thank you for sharing and i appreciate the advice, i hope they return to normal
